why: Members are nodes and each related[i][j] = 1 is an undirected edge; transitive membership means a group is a connected component. Union-find merges related members, and the group count is N minus the number of successful merges.
hints: 'Related through any chain' is the definition of what in a graph?
Count connected components: start with N singleton groups and merge whenever two related members are in different groups.
Union-find with path compression over the upper triangle of the matrix: O(N^2 alpha(N)). A DFS or BFS from each unvisited member is equivalent.
pitfalls: The diagonal related[i][i] is not a relationship with anyone else.
An isolated member is still one group.
The matrix is symmetric; visit each pair once.
constraints: • Not stated in the source. Assume 1 ≤ N ≤ 1000, related is N × N, symmetric, with entries 0 or 1.
